senses.definition: The outer wall of a feudal castle.
The space immediately within the outer wall of a castle or fortress.
(in certain proper names) A prison or court of justice.
examples: the Old Bailey in London; the New Bailey in Manchester

senses.definition: An argument which is controversial and more difficult to defend (in the context of a motte and bailey fallacy).

quotes.text: "Birds are dinosaurs" is the bailey; "birds are more similar to dinosaurs than anything else" is the motte.
